## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and why the change belongs in TokenCrate.

## Checks

- [ ] `bash tests/static.sh` passes
- [ ] `python3 tests/integration.py` passes, or the change touches nothing it
      covers
- [ ] Documentation and validation records are updated for user-visible
      behavior

[CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/angelo-lesniak/token-crate/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
says which changes need which checks and what a preset or pin change must
attach.
